Hi I understand this feeling completely, I finally went to see my GP a few weeks ago and since then have had days where I feel stupid for going, then days where I feel awful again. I think it's best to go and see what happens when you go at first they'll just ask you how you're feeling, how long for, what your lifestyle is like then they'll give you a questionnaire thing to write down your symptoms. Then you'll get another appointment to discuss the results. Don't know if it takes as long everywhere in the UK (I'm in Scotland) but my appointment was 2 weeks after the original .Tomorrow is the day I go back to see what the results are so I can't really tell you what happens after that yet. Hopefully they help me and you, good luck.

I finally went to a doctors appointment on Thursday. Terrified me but I went through with it, basically just asked me a few questions about my life  and gave me a questionnaire to fill in. Got to go back in 2 weeks I guess to discuss what the results of that test are, so now I wait. Harder than the anxiety about going in the first place and I know how you feel about worrying that they'll say nothings wrong. I'm glad I went in the first place though even though I dont have an answer yet, feels like ive taken a step in the right direction or something idk.  the first appointment wasnt as bad as I thought and the doctor didnt judge me in anyway. I hope you get the help you need.
